paper_title: Modification of acenes for n-channel OFET materials

knowledge_points.content: The primary strategy for converting electron-rich acene skeletons into n-type materials involves inducing electron deficiency by adding electron-withdrawing functionalities to lower the Lowest Unoccupied Molecular Orbital (LUMO) energy level.
knowledge_points.evidence: the general idea is to induce electron deficiency to develop an acene-based n-type material by adding electron withdrawing functionalities. Careful tuning of LUMO energy level below -4.0 eV improves the electron injection efficiency of the system and also increases the ambient stability.

knowledge_points.content: A LUMO energy level of approximately -4.0 eV or lower is theoretically and empirically required for an organic semiconductor to achieve stable electron transport under ambient conditions.
knowledge_points.evidence: A LUMO energy of ca. -4 eV or lower is required to realize stable electron transport performance for an OSC, which has been theoretically proven and empirically demonstrated.

knowledge_points.content: Perfluoropentacene (6) exhibits an electron mobility of 0.22 cm²/V·s in top-contact devices fabricated on octadecyltrimethoxysilane (OTS)-treated SiO2 dielectrics under vacuum.
knowledge_points.evidence: Top-contact devices of 6 fabricated on octadecyltrimethoxysilane (OTS)-treated dielectric SiO2 exhibited an electron mobility (μe) of 0.11 cm2 V-1 s-1 under vacuum... The device performance was further improved after optimizing the fabrication conditions, achieving a mobility of 0.22 cm2 V-1 s-1.

knowledge_points.content: In halogenated triisopropylsilyl (TIPS) acene derivatives, strictly n-type behavior is observed when the LUMO level drops below -3.15 eV and the HOMO level is below -5.6 eV.
knowledge_points.evidence: When the LUMO was below -3.15 eV and the HOMO was below -5.6 eV, the materials exhibited strictly n-type behavior, which was attributed to large hole injection barriers.

knowledge_points.content: A rubrene derivative functionalized with trifluoromethyl groups (molecule 10) demonstrated balanced ambipolar transport with hole and electron mobilities of 4.8 cm²/V·s and 4.2 cm²/V·s, respectively, in single-crystal devices.
knowledge_points.evidence: Molecule 10 is a rubrene derivative with two trifluoromethyl groups... It behaved as an ambipolar material in single crystal devices... with a remarkable hole mobility up to 4.8 cm2 V-1 s-1 and equally balanced electron mobility up to 4.2 cm2 V-1 s-1.

knowledge_points.content: Cyanation of acenes serves a dual purpose: it significantly lowers the LUMO level and promotes dense, face-to-face molecular packing, which facilitates efficient charge transport.
knowledge_points.evidence: The cyano group, being highly electron withdrawing, significantly lowers the LUMO of aromatic systems such as acenes 11–15. Additionally, it favors dense, face-to-face molecular packing, an important factor for efficient charge transport.

knowledge_points.content: Silylethynylated N-heteropentacene (18) achieved a record electron mobility of 13.3 cm²/V·s in single-crystal devices tested in a nitrogen atmosphere.
knowledge_points.evidence: The highest electron mobility of 13.3 cm2 V-1 s-1 was achieved when the devices were tested in a nitrogen atmosphere [for compound 18].

knowledge_points.content: The presence of active silanol (hydroxyl) groups on SiO2 dielectric surfaces acts as an electron trap, which can be mitigated by passivating the surface with self-assembled monolayers (SAMs) like OTS or HMDS.
knowledge_points.evidence: active hydroxyl groups on the surface (silanol) irreversibly trap electrons accumulated on the interface... An efficient way to solve this problem is to alter the surface properties by coating the dielectric surface with a modifying agent to passivate silanol groups.

knowledge_points.content: The position of nitrogen atoms in N-heteroacene isomers (e.g., 18 vs. 19) significantly influences the molecular packing motif and the resulting charge transport type, shifting behavior from strictly n-type to ambipolar.
knowledge_points.evidence: Vacuum-deposited films of 18... exhibited n-type FET behavior... 19 showed ambipolar behavior... This clearly suggests that the position of nitrogen in the acene backbone plays an important role in determining molecular packing, electronic behavior and charge carrier mobility.

knowledge_points.content: Acenequinones, such as anthracenequinone and pentacenequinone, are utilized as n-type materials by incorporating electron-deficient units like trifluoromethylphenyl, thiadiazole, or pyrazine-type nitrogen atoms.
knowledge_points.evidence: The general design strategy is to introduce electron-deficient groups to the acenequinone core. ... synthesized derivatives of anthracenequinone by introducing electron-deficient trifluoromethylphenyl groups... fluorination or introducing pyrazine-type nitrogen atoms.

knowledge_points.content: The bisthiadiazole-fused tetraaza-pentacenequinone derivative (36) possesses a very deep LUMO energy level of -4.46 eV, which contributes to its excellent stability in ambient air.
knowledge_points.evidence: bisthiadiazole-fused tetraaza-pentacenequinone, 36... displays a very deep LUMO of -4.46 eV... These devices also show excellent ambient air stability because of the deep LUMO energy level.

knowledge_points.content: Two-dimensional (2D) face-to-face pi-pi stacking is the preferred molecular packing motif for high-performance organic semiconductors compared to the edge-to-face herringbone packing typically found in neat acenes.
knowledge_points.evidence: Innately, most of the neat acenes... arrange themselves in a herringbone motif... However, studies show that face-to-face pi-stacking with shorter intermolecular distances improves charge migration... two-dimensional pi-pi stacking is known to facilitate easier charge migration.

knowledge_points.content: Silylethynyl groups (like TIPS) are used in acenes to improve solubility, prevent photo-oxidation by reducing triplet energy, and control molecular packing to favor face-to-face pi-stacking.
knowledge_points.evidence: Appropriate silylethynyl functionalization has been shown to reduce the triplet energy, thereby preventing singlet oxygen sensitization... spherical trialkylsilyl groups arrange themselves in such a way to permit exquisite control over molecular packing by forcing the acenes to assume face-to-face pi-stacking.
